properties.name: A constructor stores the status it was given, every typed edge helper keeps what a redraw leaves out, and a stale GOVERNED_BY note is corrected
properties.rationale: Asked for as the three follow-ups from phase 2 (#771). Cause of (1), walked with the root-cause skill and measured: fact:root-cause-a-constructor-wrote-its-status-only-when-the-call-settled-and-signed-whatever-it-wrote-2026-10-19 — one boolean (the settle table's) answered two questions, so #635 narrowing the Decision row silently narrowed the write. Class pinned: every constructor that takes a status stores exactly what it is given or refuses naming why, and never draws an approver edge on a status it did not store; all nine status-taking constructors are walked, every value, create and revise (tests/a_constructor_stores_the_status_it_was_given.rs, 5 of 5 failing on main 6a45d4b first). Choice: an approver with nothing to sign is NOTED, not refused, so an MCP client that passes its approver on every call keeps working (a narrowing needs a deprecating release first). (2) is the recurrence of the replace-the-bag mechanism (fact:twenty-three-of-twenty-five-typed-edge-helpers-replaced-an-edges-properties-on-a-redraw-2026-10-19); no Decision in the design says a helper must replace, so every helper now keeps (tests/a_redrawn_edge_keeps_what_the_call_leaves_out.rs, 3 of 4 failing first). No schema change: the stamp does not move for these. Two toolsnap goldens move (add_decision, add_requirement field text). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Three follow-ups from phase 2 (P3.5, PR #773). (1) add_decision and add_requirement store exactly the status given, on create and on revise: add_decision had stored rejected/superseded as proposed (with or without an approver) while drawing the approver edge, and both ignored a revise back to proposed. The settle gate now only decides whether a name is needed; an approver with nothing to sign (no status, or proposed) is not drawn and the reply says so (approver_not_drawn); an unknown status is refused before the create. (2) Every core typed edge helper draws through DesignGraph::draw_edge_keeping, so a redraw keeps the properties the call leaves out (23 of 25 helpers replaced the whole bag); depends_on takes one path with or without argued_by; create_edge still replaces. (3) The GOVERNED_BY note on req:a-near-match-across-types-or-within-a-line-of-reasoning-is-a-note-not-a-refusal now says lineage derived, which phase 2 set.
